# source location

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sourceLocation`](gmeow-sourceLocation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sourceLocation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sources`](../../slices/sources.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Where the source artifact came from — a file path, original filename, or URL. Provenance/audit only; carries no reliable identity.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:sourceLocation`](gmeow-sourceLocation.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Imported Record

- **Source:** [`slices/core/sources/examples/imported-record.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/sources/examples/imported-record.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-sources-examples-imported-record)#example-slices-core-sources-examples-imported-record

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: pinning an imported source. The sources slice is the
# "where did this byte-stream come from" layer: gmeow:sourceLocation (where it was
# read from), gmeow:sourceModifiedAt (the source's own last-modified time, not the
# import time), and gmeow:contentDigest (a content hash so later re-imports can
# detect whether the bytes changed). Together they make an imported artifact
# re-fetchable and tamper-evident — the substrate the provenance slice builds its
# wasDerivedFrom lineage on.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/sources/> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

ex:report a gmeow:CreativeWork ;
    gmeow:title            "Q3 2026 Financial Report"@en ;
    gmeow:sourceLocation   "/imports/finance/q3-2026.pdf" ;
    gmeow:sourceModifiedAt "2026-09-30T17:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime ;
    gmeow:contentDigest    "blake3:5f8d1e2a9c4b7d0e3f6a1b8c5d2e9f0a3b6c7d4e1f8a2b5c9d0e3f6a7b4c1d8e" .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record where a source artifact came from — its file path, original filename, or URL — for provenance and audit.

### Avoid when

- Avoid relying on it for identity or deduplication (paths and URLs are unstable; use [`gmeow:contentDigest`](gmeow-contentDigest.md)) and avoid treating it as the citation locator into the work (that is the [`Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) in the citations slice).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:sourceLocation`](gmeow-sourceLocation.md) on the [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) or [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md) alongside [`gmeow:contentDigest`](gmeow-contentDigest.md); read the location as audit trail and the digest as the authoritative identity.

### Scope notes

- Typically asserted on a [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) or [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md).

### Examples

- ex:report [`gmeow:sourceLocation`](gmeow-sourceLocation.md) "/imports/2026/report.pdf".

### Avoid For Consumers

- [`gmeow:consumerPublicSite`](../individuals/gmeow-consumerPublicSite.md)
